text:
harborsafe-pm: Hey team — trying to kick off onboarding for an OCR -> NER pipeline to extract invoice/PO fields. Primary goals: 200 req/s steady, p95 latency <350ms (target <200ms), and high NER precision on vendor/name/address. Data contains PII (names, addresses) but not PHI. Prefer Dedicated or Private with KMS/HSM. Can you confirm feasibility and list required evals/next steps? I'll attach a 200-sample set shortly.

sam-cs: Thanks — noted. Do you have a preferred model family (open vs vendor) and max model size? Also: are you ok with quantized weights if it hits throughput?

harborsafe-pm: Prefer open models if perf/cost comparable. We want to avoid large tails on latency; 13B is our upper bound for cost. Quantization OK if no accuracy drop >1.5% F1.

emma-cs: Looping in eng/ML for perf + safety. We should flag renewal risk if onboarding misses the SLA window — client has a Q3 go-live. I'll schedule a kickoff today.

raj-eng: For throughput 200 req/s with 13B we need dedicated pool + batching + KV prefix caching. If you can accept micro-batching (batch size 8–16) we can hit req/s but tail latency depends on arrival pattern. Also need to know avg tokens per request — invoices vary.

harborsafe-pm: Avg prompt+OCR tokens ~120, average completion tokens ~60. Bursty traffic at 2x peak during EOD.

raj-eng: Got it. Quick plan: we can bench a quantized 13B with these settings. I can run a perf job if you upload sample files. Here's a bench snippet you can expect us to run:

```
# perf-run.sh (example)
curl -X POST https://bench.redwood.example/v1/bench \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"model":"13b-quant", "batch_size":8, "concurrency":50, "requests":10000, "prompt_len":120, "completion_len":60}'
```

lina-ml: On safety: we'll run NER precision/recall, redaction checks for PII leakage, and hallucination tests where we blank out OCR tokens to see hallucinated fills. Suggested thresholds: NER F1 >= 0.87, redaction recall >= 0.95, hallucination rate < 2%. Also need to run cultural/locale checks for address parsing.

sam-cs: Ops question — do you need Private (VPC) or is Dedicated in our hosted infra sufficient for compliance? Private w/ HSM adds 2–3 week lead time.

harborsafe-pm: They require customer-managed KMS and audit logs; so Private with HSM preferred. What does the lead time look like for a small pilot?

emma-cs: Pilot on Dedicated hosted infra first (3 business days for bench + report), then move to Private for production. Private provisioning for a single customer environment typically 2–3 weeks + security review. That creates a renewal risk window if we miss timelines — I'll mark the account as watch and coordinate. :eyes:

raj-eng: To start the bench I need the sample payloads and an S3 link + expected latency SLOs for canary (p95 vs p99). Please upload to the cs-buckets/harborsafe/onboard folder.

harborsafe-pm: Uploaded: s3://cs-buckets/harborsafe/onboard/sample-200.zip — includes OCR outputs + expected ground-truth NER labels.

lina-ml: Perfect. I'll add synthetic edge-cases (OCR noise, non-latin chars) to the set. Also will prepare an eval notebook with metrics and failure examples for the enablement call.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4521 (HarborSafe onboarding). Assigned: sam-cs, raj-eng, lina-ml. Estimated bench ETA: 3 business days.

deploy-bot: Reminder: allocate Dedicated pool 'dp-harborsafe-13b' for perf job when bench starts.

harborsafe-pm: Great — thanks all. Can you confirm timeline for a short trial (4–6 weeks) once Private env is provisioned? Need that for our procurement.

emma-cs: Yes — we can do a 4-week pilot in Private after provisioning. I'll send draft SOW and procurement checklist today.

sam-cs: Next action items: 1) raj runs perf bench on uploaded set, 2) lina runs safety/eval notebook, 3) emma sends SOW + marks account watch. We'll post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

harborsafe-pm: Thanks — looking forward to the bench results.
